content.text: Mapped action names to the SIEM schema; need a secrets grant for the intake token in staging before enabling the publisher flag.

Support portal audit events (login, dispute filed, contact email change, invoice download) currently sit only in the application Postgres audit table. Security wants them in the shared SIEM pipeline alongside app and API logs.

Wire the existing audit publisher to emit portal events to the SIEM HTTPS intake with fields actor_id, tenant_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, ip, and user_agent. Acceptance: staging SIEM shows portal.login and portal.dispute.create within 60 seconds of the action, with a runbook snippet for on-call to query them. No change to customer-visible portal behavior.
